summary: Mercury aspecting the lagna (Mercury in the 7th) gives intelligence, skill in arts and crafts that earns money, fame and honour; it strengthens the lagna.
common_outcomes: rich knowledge of the arts and gains through them (Saravali 34.1-7)
intelligent, famous and honourable (Saravali 34.1-7)
the lagna is strong when aspected by Mercury, Jupiter or its own lord and free of other aspects (Phaladeepika 4.6)
rare_outcomes: Aspects on the natal Moon (the Moon as second lagna, BPHS ch. 12): Phaladeepika 18.6-11 gives Mercury's aspect on the Moon as learning in Aries and Cancer; thievishness in Taurus; kingly status in Gemini, Virgo, Libra, Capricorn and Aquarius; an astrologer in Leo; a father of twins in Scorpio; protector of kin in Sagittarius; wit in Pisces.
Raman's chart notes: Mercury, Venus and the Sun aspecting a Taurus lagna gave acting talent; Mercury aspecting a Scorpio lagna (with Jupiter) in an editor's chart (HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV).
strengtheners: Phaladeepika 4.6: Mercury's aspect strengthens the lagna.
Saravali 34.8: Gemini or Virgo lagna aspected by its lord Mercury gives happiness, wealth and closeness to rulers.
Saravali 34.10-11: one benefic aspecting the lagna is auspicious.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Frawley pp. 236-237: under malefic influence Mercury is not a benefic.
lagna_or_context_notes: Mercury casts only the 7th aspect in full, so it aspects house 1 from the 7th house.

summary: Mercury's aspect on the 2nd is double-edged in Saravali: on a lone Saturn there it brings great riches, but on Jupiter or a weak Moon there it drains wealth; Raman links it with self-earned money and mathematical skill.
common_outcomes: Saturn alone in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: great wealth (Saravali 34.15-20)
Mars in the 2nd aspected by Mercury (or with the Moon): a good mathematician (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5)
Moon in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: earning by self-effort (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5)
rare_outcomes: Jupiter in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: the wealth earned is lost (Saravali 34.15-20).
Weak Moon in the 2nd aspected by Mercury: even ancestral property is lost and other income is hindered (Saravali 34.15-20).

by_area.personality: Numeracy and quick speech (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5).
by_area.finance: Mixed: wealth through effort and commerce, but the texts warn of losses depending on which planet occupies the 2nd (Saravali 34.15-20; Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 5).

strengtheners: Benefics in the 2nd bring money in many ways (Saravali 34.15-20).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.15-20: Mercury's aspect on Jupiter or a weak Moon in the 2nd.
lagna_or_context_notes: Mercury casts only the 7th aspect in full, so it aspects house 2 from the 8th house.

Mercury in its own 5th aspected by the Moon: a child by adoption (Saravali 34.29 - this is the Moon's aspect, recorded here for completeness).

strengtheners: Strength of Mercury and of the 5th lord (BPHS 16.12).
